subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To cut someone some slack

options.text: Avoid talking about problems till the very end
To not manage someone very strictly or critically

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****To not manage someone very strictly or critically****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To cut someone some slack"** means to not manage someone very strictly or critically. (किसी को बहुत सख्ती या आलोचना के साथ नहीं संभालना)

 
 
• **Example:** She’s new to the job, so let’s **cut her some slack**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is To not manage someone very strictly or critically.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** Avoid talking about problems till the very end (समस्याओं के बारे में अंत तक बात करने से बचना)

 
 
• **Example:** It's not wise to **avoid talking about problems** till the very end; it’s better to address them early.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** To get the conversation going (बातचीत को शुरू करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He told a joke **to get the conversation going** at the party.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** To criticize someone very strictly (किसी की बहुत सख्ती से आलोचना करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The coach **criticized the players very strictly** after their poor performance.
